'''2009 North Dakota State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship played on Saturday 9 May 2009 at Paradox Comics-N-Cards, 26 Roberts Street, Fargo, North Dakota, with [[Tyler Vastag]] as main tournament director.<ref name="sf-25847-400287">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=400287#p400287 2009 ND States], The Smoking Gungan (Brian Herold), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (10 April 2009).</ref> Fifteen players took part.<ref name="sf-25847-411520">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=411520#p411520 2009 ND States], Jeeps (Peter Jacobson), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (9 May 2009).</ref> [[Brian Herold]] won the title and the trophy; [[Tom Frafjord]], who finished second, took the bye to Day 2 of the [[2009 World Championship]] and the virtual card design opportunity.<ref name="sf-25847-414386">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=414386#p414386 2009 ND States], The Smoking Gungan (Brian Herold), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (17 May 2009).</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Paradox Comics-N-Cards, 26 Roberts Street, Fargo, North Dakota<ref name="sf-25847-400287" />
* '''Dates:''' 9 May 2009<ref name="sf-25847-400287" />
* '''Time:''' registration from 10:30 am; play from 11 am<ref name="sf-25847-400287" />
* '''Format:''' six-game Swiss with a final confrontation between the top two players; Open format, with all virtual cards legal<ref name="sf-25847-400287" />; decklists not required<ref name="sf-25847-409659">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=409659#p409659 2009 ND States], The Smoking Gungan (Brian Herold), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (5 May 2009).</ref>
* '''Entry fee:''' $10 at the door<ref name="sf-25847-400287" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Tyler Vastag]] as main TD, under the three-judge system that let the TD play in a state-level event; the other two judges were chosen before game 1<ref name="sf-25847-400287" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Herold]]<ref name="sf-25847-414386" />

== Organization ==

[[Adam Howland]] opened the forum thread on 23 February 2009 by asking who would come to North Dakota States at the end of April or the beginning of May.<ref name="sf-25847-381846">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=381846#p381846 2009 ND States], MasterJediAdam (Adam Howland), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (23 February 2009).</ref> [[John Anderson]] spoke to Paradox, for whom 9 May worked best: 2 May and 18 April were already booked, and on 25 April the store would be shared with a ''Magic'' prerelease.<ref name="sf-25847-389526">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=389526#p389526 2009 ND States], The Smoking Gungan (Brian Herold), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (15 March 2009).</ref> Anderson noted that the 2008 state championship had also been held on Mother's Day weekend.<ref name="sf-25847-386915">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=386915#p386915 2009 ND States], puck71 (John Anderson), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (7 March 2009).</ref> He also wrote that 2 May was the weekend of the Texas Mini Worlds, which some of the North Dakota players would attend, and was Free Comic Book Day, when the store was not available for a tournament.<ref name="sf-25847-391479">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=391479#p391479 2009 ND States], puck71 (John Anderson), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (20 March 2009).</ref>

Herold posted the official announcement on 10 April 2009, billing the event as "Pwn in the Flood Zone 2009". The organizers bought the Players Committee's Ultimate Package, so the winner would receive a virtual card design opportunity, a glass trophy and a bye to Day 2 of the 2009 World Championship. Other prizes were 30 booster packs, 30 random rares, three random EPP/EJP/ECC tuck packs, six [[tournament foils]], posters, pins and Paradox gift cards. Paradox let the players use the store for free.<ref name="sf-25847-400287" /> On 5 May Herold announced that decklists were not required.<ref name="sf-25847-409659" />

== Results ==

Herold wrote on the evening of the event that he had won. Frafjord had the higher differential at the end of the Swiss rounds but declined the final confrontation so that everyone could get home earlier.<ref name="sf-25847-411640">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=411640#p411640 2009 ND States], The Smoking Gungan (Brian Herold), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (10 May 2009).</ref> Herold posted the final standings on 17 May 2009:<ref name="sf-25847-414386" />
